## Credited prior refutation

Problem 30002729 / OWR-13353-017, rank 1244, is accepted as a prior refutation of the universal additive inequality L <= L* + 11D/10 for finite undirected rings. Zero new proof turns are used. The construction is credited to Georgiev, Gómez-Serrano, Tao, and Wagner's [AlphaEvolve work](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.02864), Section 41, and the optimum-gap transfer to [Däubel, Lemma 7](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.02119). The target is [Skutella's OWR Conjecture 1](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2014/51), printed page 2917.

The recorded exact witness audit, together with the complete authored transfer proof, gives L-L*>1.119D>11D/10. The edition makes no new-discovery, historical-priority, or optimal-additive-constant claim.

## Complete mathematical audit and external witness

The complete mathematical audit is retained, including the distinction between discrepancy relative to a selected split routing and a gap between optimum loads. The supplied proof gives two- and four-edge capped-demand equalization blocks, bottom-up normalization that never increases the maximum load, the explicit weighted split-optimality certificate, preservation of the maximum complete demand, and distinct endpoint pairs. The normalization does not assert that every individual edge load is nonincreasing.

The mathematical body and verification-extent section are unchanged byte for byte. The reported audit checked all 32,768 original choices in three formulations and the 832 applicable local gadget assignments. These counts describe the completed verification scope; they are not a distributed computational certificate. The public [pinned notebook](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphaevolve_repository_of_problems/blob/8f447457957deac61e28bf1676746f0753b3b2f8/experiments/ring_loading_problem/ring_loading_problem.ipynb) supplies the external witness. Reproducing its finite check requires retrieving that source and independently performing exact verification.

The audit is AI-assisted and unrefereed. Acceptance is not external human peer review, journal acceptance, or formal proof-assistant certification. Public notebook/PDF identities, byte counts, exact-match history, audit extent, source inspection history, and manuscript-status/version limits are preserved. In particular, the retained AlphaEvolve PDF is v1, the recorded latest official check is v3, and the Däubel inspection is v2. Edition preparation makes no new source retrieval, rehash, inspection, or literature-search claim.

## Exact addition-only boundary

Exactly five authored audit/status/metadata files are added under unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30002729/. No QUEUE or historical-accounting changes, source notebook/PDF bodies, source-derived vectors or demand tables, programs, raw computational outputs, private sources, or private coordination material are included. No excluded data or computations are rewritten as prose.

Strict local clean-patch replay and native Git blob/tree checks passed. The complete expected tree chain preserves all unrelated entries. These checks establish packaging integrity and do not claim remote verification or CI success. Draft review publication only; no merge, release, DOI, or outside outreach.

Base commit: `f6caddda8f8be2cdb3e91494325d8f7f365bc3fc`.
